sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Irfan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.42 of 2019 at Police Station-Mahila Thana, District-Rampur under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 18.06.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 18.06.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Mohd. Irfan, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the brother-in-law of the victim.
2. The F.I.R. arises out of a matrimonial dispute.
3. The applicant never tortured the deceased nor demanded dowry.
The applicant resides separately.

Tejpal vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185154544/
1
4. False and aggravated allegations have been made at the instigation of the interested parties to leverage the criminal case in the matrimonial dispute.
5. Upon investigation a final report was filed by the police exonerating the applicant.
6. Medical evidence does not corroborate the commission of rape.
7. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
8. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Tejpal be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
Order Date :- 20.7.2023/
